output.reason: The release note [ev-9761b3519d5c] says a new pattern variable, %SERVICE_NAME%, was added for the stat prefix. The linked issue [ev-fce32ea1fd6a] names the config fields that take it, inboundClusterStatName and outboundClusterStatName, and says the variable is replaced with the service's name. [ev-6b6b0ca5d646] explains why: the same service runs in several namespaces, and the requester wants their metrics grouped together. Together these give the subject (the %SERVICE_NAME% variable in those two fields), the change (a new variable added) and the exposure (only operators who choose to use it in those patterns). Confidence is low because the field names come from the feature request, not from the merged change, and the release note does not mention the %SERVICE_NAMESPACE% variable the issue also asked for.
